releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 10
releases.body:
# AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 10

Beta 10 adds **global physical-controller profiles** and improves Mophun sound and game speed.

Open **Settings → Physical controller profiles** to edit the global mapping or create reusable profiles for buttons and both sticks. Assign them to games from the manager or each game's Controls page. Graphics, touch layouts and physical mappings stay independent. Existing per-game overrides take priority; shared changes apply the next time the game opens. Profiles are included in library backups.

Mophun sound is now enabled for every game. Short BEEP effects and `vBeep` are supported, and PCM follows pause and emulation speed. A common phone-model execution budget reduces excessive speed in CPU-dependent games such as the supplied Boulder Dash and Lemtris versions.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.10.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and experimental Symbian/N-Gage.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.10-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Android 10+ is required. Both update the existing app in place. Back up important saves before updating or switching architecture. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

Boulder Dash 1.1 and Lemtris 1.0 for T61

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 9
releases.body:
Beta 9 adds **independent right-stick mapping** for physical controllers.

Open **Controls → Controller mapping → Sticks** to assign the right stick’s directions and diagonals to phone keys, soft keys or Fire. **Identify** detects right-stick movement; pressing R3 remains a separate input. Bindings are saved per game, and existing profiles keep their settings with the new directions unbound.

The shared input path supports Java ME, Mophun and Symbian/N-Gage. This maps stick directions to digital keys; it does not add proportional analog camera support to games.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.9.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and experimental Symbian/N-Gage.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.9-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Android 10+ is required. Both update the existing app in place.

Tested with automated input and a virtual joystick on Retroid; physical dual-stick hardware testing remains pending. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 8
releases.body:
Beta 8 fixes Lara's black/striped appearance and loading-screen text showing through her model in **Tomb Raider: Underworld 3D**. The cause was incorrect transparency when transferring M3G rendering to the Java ME screen.

Startup errors now show the original game exception instead of only `InvocationTargetException`.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.8.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and the combined Symbian runtime.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.8-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Both require Android 10+ and update the existing app without uninstalling.

The reported **Crash Titans 1.3.7 Sony S700i JAR** was also checked. Its code and packed resources are inconsistent; the same reader fails on ordinary Java outside AbyssME. This release does not make that particular JAR playable.

Checks: 427 JVM tests per build, focused Retroid renderer tests, signed APK update and first-room checks. This is not complete-game acceptance. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.body:
# AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 6

## Shared profiles and extra touch buttons

- Set global touch/LCD defaults and create named profiles from **Settings →
  Profiles / Global defaults**. Link individual games or assign a profile to
  several prepared games. Edit a shared profile once; linked games use it on
  their next launch.
- Keep per-game exceptions, inspect which profile supplies each setting, and
  reset individual overrides. Existing game settings stay unchanged on upgrade;
  explicitly reset their touch/LCD overrides to adopt shared settings.
- Add up to twelve independent Gamepad buttons in **Edit touch layout → Extra**.
  Choose a key and label, size, opacity and separate portrait/landscape positions.
  Additional buttons are included in shared profiles.
- Library backups carry profile definitions and assignments. Phone backups carry
  portable per-game definitions. Restore preserves destination profiles when
  names or identities conflict.

releases.name: ARMSX3 for iOS 0.0.2 beta
releases.body:
Changes since 0.0.1. Thanks to everyone who sent problem reports, since most of these fixes came from them. This is a beta: the JIT changes ran on an iPhone, and everything else was tested on a Mac. Please send a report if something works worse than in 0.0.1.

## Requirements and install

ARMSX3 for iOS needs an iPhone or iPad with an A14 chip or newer, on iOS 17.4 or later. It isn't on the App Store, so install the IPA with SideStore, AltStore or LiveContainer. JIT needs a pairing file for your device (see Pairing files below).

## Update LiveContainer first

If you run ARMSX3 inside LiveContainer, update LiveContainer to 3.8.13 or later before you install this build. That is the nightly build at the moment: https://github.com/LiveContainer/LiveContainer/releases/tag/nightly Older versions can't load the JIT helper, and ARMSX3 will fall back to StikDebug.

In LiveContainer, turn on Helper Process Support for ARMSX3, and open ARMSX3 full screen, not in a window.

## Built-in JIT inside LiveContainer

ARMSX3 can now turn on JIT by itself inside LiveContainer, the same way it already did when installed on its own. You no longer need StikDebug for this. We tested it inside LiveContain

新增：开发者选项支持隐藏 OCR 置信度不足或未识别到有效文字时的红色提示。

优化：主页布局，更方便地查看预设、当前状态、截屏服务和批量翻译任务。

优化：设置选择控件，统一选中块样式，增加滑动切换效果，并调整高度、边距与交互反馈。

优化：自动识别设置，使用语言卡片管理识别方式、模型选择和下载状态。

优化：初始化引导选择日文、韩文、俄语、白俄罗斯语、乌克兰语、中文或英文时会匹配对应 OCR；其它源语言默认推荐 PaddleOCR v5 mobile。

优化：相册图片导入与系统分享流程，改善批量翻译任务的创建和处理体验。

优化：模型下载进度、速度显示、失败恢复和就绪检查，整理语音模型下载状态展示；完善本地翻译模型的加载方式、旧配置迁移与资源释放。

优化：设置保存、预设管理、首页提示与词典交互，改善识别、屏幕旋转和循环翻译时的显示，减少配置丢失及使用过程中的崩溃。

# v0.4.5 主要更新

新增：术语库支持从 JSON 文件批量导入，可在导入前预览、筛选并处理重复内容。

新增：悬浮窗支持点击英文单词查看简要释义，并可打开完整词卡。

优化：调整日文、中文、韩文和拉丁文字识别流程，并改进 Paddle OCR 的批量识别与竖排文字处理。

优化：改进同屏、连续和全部合并翻译的顺序、结果对应与异常恢复，减少重复请求和翻译失败。

优化：统一欢迎页与设置页的模型推荐、下载检查和离线方案选择。

修复：若干悬浮窗、原文覆盖、设置状态和界面显示问题。

# Lichii-Enhanced v1.0.0: first public release

Lichii-Enhanced is a fork of [Lichii](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii) focused on usability: easier setup, built-in upscaling, non-destructive modding and more reliable online play. This is the first public release.

### 🖼️ Built-in upscalers
Upscaling is now part of the renderer; no external injectors or wrappers are needed.

- New post-process stage at the end of the Vulkan frame (compute shaders), running after game rendering and before swapchain presentation
- Filters: Nearest, Bilinear, Bicubic, FSR 1.0 (EASU + RCAS), SGSR
- Configurable render scale and sharpness (RCAS strength)
- Per-game profiles stored in `config/custom/<title-id>.ini`
- Optional anti-aliasing pass before upscaling

# 说明
从Winlator-Glibc v2版本开始项目将使用全新命名空间，这意味着你可以无需删除曾经的v1或者7.1.6版本即可安装此版本，但是我依然推荐你将曾经的版本删除，以后我将只为拥有新命名空间的版本进行软件包的更新与维护，新旧版本的 Wine、Box64、Turnip 等组件不再兼容，也无法混用。
# 更新内容
- 使用全新安卓命名空间
- 重新编译rootfs
- 支持 Vulkan 1.4+ API
- 弃用X Server服务，使用Termux-X11作为显示后端（来自[ewt45](https://github.com/[ewt45](https://github.com/ewt45))）
- 升级Zink版本，Zink版本将与Turnip版本同步更新

- 优化安卓层面的性能监控，GPU采用获取真实数据逻辑
- 添加KDE桌面鼠标主题，可在编辑容器界面中的Wine配置选项中切换主题与鼠标大小
# Bug修复
- 修复启动容器与退出容器有几率崩溃的问题（来自[ewt45](https://github.com/[ewt45](https://github.com/ewt45))）
- 修复摇杆无法自由移动的问题
- 修复快捷方式中"添加到主屏幕"功能不可用的问题
- 修复虚拟控件手柄摇杆有几率卡住的问题
- 修复使用桌面快捷方式启动容器应用时无法启动的问题

- 由于Termux-X11的渲染问题，在容器中使用"创建快捷方式"功能的时候会触发渲染错误，退出容器后重新启动即可解决，此问题并不影响快捷方式的创建

releases.name: YukiHub v0.3
releases.body:
# YukiHub v0.3 更新简介

> 本次更新聚焦：**UI 全面焕新 · 大屏模式 · 展厅功能 · 资讯与正版导购 · 账号体验 · 大量稳定性修复**

## ✨ 全新功能

- **大屏模式（主打）**：全新大屏播放体验，支持在大屏上畅享游戏 PV；新增从**文件夹**选取视频的来源（部分设备受系统限制无法从相册正常浏览图集，只能按时间一个个翻，很麻烦，现已绕开）。
- **首页接入 Gal 资讯**：打开 App 即可浏览最新 Galgame 动态。
- **正式接入 NextMoe 数据源**：账号快捷登录同步迁移为 **NextMoe·未萌** 快捷登录；聊天室支持 NextMoe 表情包。
- **游戏库正版导购**：网页社区游戏库新增游戏详情页，接入 **DLsite 正版链接** 与 **Steam 正版链接**（通过 Steam API 显示实时价格）。接入 NextMoe 分销链接，流量好的话后续会在社区发放 DL 正版游戏优惠券。
- **忘记密码 / 找回密码**：支持自助找回账号。
- **游戏时长编辑**：支持手动编辑游戏时长记录。
- **展厅玩法扩展**：3D 游戏展厅与多人在线展厅持续建设中，本版本新增音乐间（离线展厅可播放玩家自行导入的游戏专辑音乐），并支持共同观影等多人互动玩法。
- **多人在线展厅（重磅）**：全新网页端多人 3D 展厅上线！和朋友一起在线逛街、聊天、互动，包含：
  - 影院：共同观影、点播排队、投票换片、管理员管理（强制播放/跳片、远程灯光等）；
  - 音乐间：播放玩家自行导入的游戏专辑音乐，附赠一台古典音乐播放机；
  - 钓鱼等小游戏与更多互动玩法；
  - 离线展厅同步升级音乐间。
- **3D 游戏展厅**：以"逛博物馆"的仪式感重新设计，游戏以实体盒子陈列在虚拟 3D 房间中。

## 🎨 体验优化

- **UI 全面焕新**：整体视觉语言与配色体系全面重设计，界面更现代、更统一，观感焕然一新。
- 注册 / 登录页交互逻辑全面优化。
- 首页、游戏库按钮样式与配色统一化，UI 细节全面打磨。
- 手柄适配继续完善。
- 融合 GalToolbox 能力。
- 软件内更新默认源切换至 **GitCode**。
- 鲲 Gal 域名变更同步。

## 🛠 问题修复

- 修复好友列表"离线用户仍显示正在游玩"的 bug（根因为游戏时长未成功回传形成记录闭环）。
- 修复聊天室图片只缓存一半的问题。
- 修复验证码无动画反馈的问题。
- 修复共存版无法扫描添加文件的问题（初始库默认缺失生成项）。
- 修复游戏时长相关的若干功能 bug。
- ONS 游戏：视频播放改为**长按 2 秒跳过**（原为点击跳过，避免误触）。

## 📌 说明

- **PC 端同步**：PC 端版

# YukiHub v0.4 更新日志

> 本次更新聚焦：**刮削源升级 · FVP 引擎画质与音频修复 · 内置文件提取 · 社区收藏集**

## ✨ 全新功能

- **内置文件提取器**：现在可以直接从 MT 管理器等文件工具访问 YukiHub 的内部文件夹。
- **游戏库支持隐藏游戏**：新增「隐藏」分类，可以把不想出现在主列表里的游戏藏起来，需要时再恢复。
- **大屏模式新增回首页按钮**：右上角可直接退出大屏模式回到首页；原设置按钮同步改为图案化设计，并增加点击动效。
- **Yuki社区新增收藏集功能**（萌萌点回收计划二期）。

## 🎨 体验优化

- **默认刮削源更换为 NextMoe**：相比 VNDB 数据更完整、匹配更准。
- **好友列表排序优化**：改为按最后上线时间排序，且**有未读消息的好友优先排在前面**。
- **KRKR 新增内部存储启动**（实验性）：部分游戏可能受益，目前效果有限，暂时保留。

## 🛠 问题修复

### FVP 引擎

- **同步上游源码修复**：修复部分贴图 bug；场景跳转开始带有转场效果。
- **修复《樱花萌放》Steam 官中版部分文本乱码**：已从引擎侧完成编码映射修复。
- **修复转场黑屏**：等待上游修复的转场黑屏问题已随本次同步解决。
- **修复《はっぴぃ☆マーガレット!》汉化问题**。
- **修复对话框背景白色不透明**：对话框背景现在会正确显示为半透明，且设置里的「窗口颜色」R/G/B/A 滑条**可实时生效**。
- **修复游戏爆音**：修正了音量与声道的单位换算错误，响度不再溢出削波。

## 📌 说明

- **隐藏游戏**：隐藏后的游戏会移入「隐藏」分类，可在该分类中随时恢复显示。
- **KRKR 内部存储启动**：属实验性功能，效果因游戏而异，如遇异常可改回原启动方式。
- **FVP 引擎更新仅涉及引擎侧**：不改变存档格式，原有存档可正常读取。

---

感谢每一位玩家的反馈与支持，祝游玩愉快！🎮

releases.body:
## Changes since build 160

Built from nx2 87d84d513c. Build 160 was 2eb5f08. That's 86 merged changes.

> **The yuzu name is gone.** The build system, source folders, Qt frontend, translations, emulator libraries and docs now say Lichii instead of the name inherited from yuzu. Your settings, saves and shader caches are kept: config keys, data folders and cache formats don't change, and the few on-disk names that still carry the old name (the shader cache's file magic, the save-size file inside saves, the import path for yuzu data) stay as they are. The program files are still called `lichii`, `eden-cli` and `eden-room`. On macOS the app's bundle id changed, so macOS asks for camera and input permission again (#1541, #1550, #1551, #1552, #1553, #1544, #1582).

### Big fixes
- **Ocarina of Time: the far forest no longer floats, and Hyrule Field's frame rate is back.** In test builds after build 160, the far pine forest in Hyrule Field and in Kakariko at night was drawn unculled and partly above the ridge, and a spot that ran at 40 fps dropped to 27 fps (RTX 3080). An upstream change that came in with the Eglantine sync (#1462) generated the shader helpers for these foliage programs

releases.name: Lichii nx2 build 160 (2eb5f08)
releases.body:
## Changes since build 150

Built from nx2 2eb5f081c8. Build 150 was 17baed7. That's 30 merged changes.

> **New look.** Lichii now opens in the new **Lichii Dark** theme, and a short **What's new** window explains what moved. You can reopen it from **Help → What's New**, and the old themes are still in the settings.

### Big fixes
- **Yoshi and the Mysterious Book: the 3D world renders.** Three shader forms the game uses were rejected, which left the world black. Built on ggonzalospineli-ops' #1189 and FrsrG's #1284, with ALD/OUT from MythosOfs (#1363).
- **The Duskbloods network test: boots to its menus.** It no longer aborts on memory, and its shader forms are supported. By cerroverb (#552, #851). It still stops at its online checks. It also always uses reactive flushing, gets the DLSS replacement (#828, #637), and has a 3D colour-target clear fix (#638).
- **Ocarina of Time: the guard house freeze is fixed** by a built-in Texture Pool x2 patch (#1313).
- **Mario Kart World: characters and karts are lit correctly.** Read-only compute bindings are sized from their size word (#1333).
- **No more crash when antivirus deletes nxformat.dll.** nxformat 1.0.3 is now built into Lichii.

releases.name: Lichii nx2 build 150 (17baed7)
releases.body:
> **New here or getting bad performance?** Stop the game, then use **Help → Apply Recommended Settings...** to apply the recommended settings in one click. **Help → Restore My Previous Settings** undoes it.

Automatic build of `nx2` at 17baed716da04fd743fbd8f9604bec96eab0a123.

## What changed since build 130

Build 150 was built from nx2 17baed716d. Build 130 was 3dae119. That's 51 merged changes.

## Big fixes
- **Ocarina of Time: white wash / blown-out lighting fixed.** Destroyed GPU memory kept its old backing, so reused memory showed stale pages. Diagnosis and fix by 99ivs, with a safety refresh by PantACRO4life (#1236).
- **Mario Kart World: dark characters and karts fixed.** Compute shaders reading lighting data were cut off at 8 MiB and now see the whole buffer (#1231).
- **Ocarina of Time: out-of-memory crash on Windows.** The texture cache now stays within Windows' memory commit limit (#1210).
- **Ocarina of Time: ocarina crackle fixed** (ADPCM sign) (#1196).
- **Ocarina of Time: dark fairy fountain and Water Temple walls.** These are dumps with damaged texture members. Lichii now serves a stand-in instead of black (#1197).

## New features
- **NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 settings.**
